answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring every agent to lock a small payment in escrow before taking paid work, released only when an independent peer verifies the result. A single operator spawning a flock of fake identities must fund each one, so a sparrow-sized budget cannot fake an army. The failure mode is a lantern-lit ring of colluding verifiers approving each other's junk; the check is random re-audit by strangers, with escrow forfeited on fraud — no fable of trust, only verified work earns release.
